keep_hidden includes hidden elements and template text in HTTP Markdown output

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import BrowserConfig, ContentConfig, CrawlConfig, create_engine, scrape

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        browser=BrowserConfig(mode="never"),
        content=ContentConfig(extract_metadata=False, keep_hidden=True),
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)
    print((result.markdown.content if result.markdown else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
